howto.name: Upload images
howto.text: Select one or more JPG, PNG, or WebP images containing EXIF metadata.

howto.name: Preview metadata
howto.text: The tool displays found metadata: GPS coordinates, camera model, date taken, software, and more.

howto.name: Strip metadata and download
howto.text: Click Remove. All EXIF, IPTC, and XMP metadata is permanently stripped. The pixel data is untouched.

faq.a: All EXIF, IPTC, and XMP metadata — including GPS coordinates, camera model, date/time, software used, and thumbnail previews.

faq.q: Does removing EXIF data change image quality?
faq.a: No. Only the metadata bytes are removed. The actual image pixels are not re-encoded or modified in any way.

faq.q: Why should I remove EXIF data?
faq.a: EXIF data can contain your GPS location, device identifiers, and timestamps. Removing it before sharing photos online protects your privacy.
